name.title: The name
name.body: The name as you say it to customers (e.g. “Rice 25 kg”).

prices.title: The prices
prices.body: The selling price is required. The cost price lets us work out your margin.

stock.title: The quantity
stock.body: The unit (piece, kg, carton…) and the quantity you have today.

items.q: How do I add my products?
items.a: Go to **Stock › Products** then **Add**. Three options: **Add a product** (full form with photo), **Quick add** (several products at once) or **Import products** from an Excel file.

items.q: How do I make my first sale?
items.a: Open **New Sale**. Tap a product (or search for it, or scan its barcode) to add it to the cart, choose the payment method and tap **Checkout**. Stock updates automatically.

items.q: How do I invite an employee?
items.a: Go to **Team** then **Invite**. Enter their name and email, choose the shop and their role (cashier, stock manager…). They receive a link to set their password.

items.q: I run several shops: how do I switch between them?
items.a: The shop selector is at the top (in the sidebar on a computer). Pick a shop, or **All shops** to see combined figures. The badge under each page title always shows where you are.

items.q: What are a shop’s short name and color for?
items.a: In **Settings**, give each shop a short name (“Akwa”) and a color. They appear wherever space is tight: selector, transfers, “All shops” lists. The full name stays on receipts.

items.q: How do I sell on credit?
items.a: In **New Sale**, choose a customer (required for credit) then the **Credit** payment method, or collect only part of the amount. The rest appears in **Credits**.

items.q: How do I record a repayment?
items.a: Go to **Credits**, **Owed to me** tab, then **Repay** on the customer’s card. The amount is applied to their oldest invoices. **History** shows all their purchases and payments, with a printable **Statement**.

items.q: How do I put a sale on hold?
items.a: During a sale, tap **Hold**: the cart is set aside and its items stay reserved. Find it later in **Pending invoices**, then **Resume**.

items.q: How do I cancel or edit a sale?
items.a: In **Sales History**, open the sale then **Edit** or **Cancel**. Depending on your role, these actions may be reserved for the owner or the manager. Every change is recorded in the log.

items.q: How do I print or send a receipt?
items.a: After checkout, choose **Print receipt** (Bluetooth printer or PDF) or **WhatsApp**. From the history, each sale also offers **Print receipt** and **PDF receipt**.

items.q: How am I warned when a product is running out?
items.a: Each product has an **alert threshold**. Below it, the product is **Low stock**; at zero available, **Out of stock**. The Stock **Overview** and the **Dashboard** show them.

items.q: How do I restock?
items.a: On a product’s sheet, **Restock** adds a delivery you received. To prepare an order, the **Replenishment** tab lists the products to order, grouped by supplier, with a suggested quantity, then creates the purchase orders.

items.q: How do I track expiry dates?
items.a: Enter the date when receiving: it is stored on the **batch**. The **Lots & expiry** tab shows expired batches and those expiring soon, so you can handle them (promotion, removal, correction).

items.q: How do I do a stock count?
items.a: In **Stock › Inventories**, start a count then count each product. At the end only the differences are listed: give a reason for each before confirming.

items.q: How do I send stock to another shop?
items.a: In **Stock › Transfers**, **New transfer**: choose the destination shop and the products, then **Send**. The receiving shop confirms receipt (with the transfer’s QR code) and reports any difference.

items.q: A customer asks for an out-of-stock product: what can I do?
items.a: At checkout, the **elsewhere** label shows the company’s other shops that have it in stock, with the exact quantity. You can direct the customer there or **Request** a transfer from that shop.

items.q: How do I pay for my subscription?
items.a: Go to **Subscription**, choose your plan and your payment method (Mobile Money, card…) depending on your country.

items.q: What happens if my subscription expires?
items.a: Your data is kept. Sales and changes are paused until you renew; nothing is deleted.

items.q: Can I change plans?
items.a: Yes, at any time from **Subscription**. A higher plan applies right away and the days already paid are deducted. A lower plan starts at the end of the paid period. **Renew** early to add the new period after the current one.

items.q: Can I get a refund?
items.a: The 30-day free trial lets you try everything before paying: subscriptions are not refunded. The only exception is a payment made by mistake, reported within 48 hours to **support@stockshop.tech**.

items.q: How does referral work?
items.a: In **Settings › Referrals**, share your code. When a referred merchant becomes a customer, you earn a reward you can use on your subscription or withdraw.

items.q: Does the app work without internet?
items.a: Yes for checkout: sales made offline are kept on the device and sent as soon as the connection returns. Other screens need internet to be up to date.

items.q: How do I change the language or switch to dark mode?
items.a: Tap your **avatar** (your initials, top right): **Language** and **Dark mode** are in that menu, with **What’s new**, **Help** and **Log out**.

items.q: How do I get notifications?
items.a: Tap **Enable** on the “Receive notifications” card. Then choose in **Settings** the ones you want (new sale, expense, expiry…).

items.q: Is my data safe?
items.a: Yes. Each employee only sees what their role allows (the cost price, for example, can be hidden), all connections are encrypted and important actions are recorded in the log.

help.meta_desc: Frequently asked questions about StockShop: free trial, offline use, devices, shops, team, subscription. And how to write to us.
help.title: Frequently asked questions
help.lead: Answers to the questions asked most before getting started. Another question? Write to us.
help.q_card: Do I need a bank card for the trial?
help.a_card: No. The trial lasts 30 days with everything in Pro, no bank card needed. At the end, you choose your plan: nothing is charged automatically.
help.q_devices: Which devices does StockShop work on?
help.a_devices: Phone, tablet and computer. On Android, install the app from the Play Store; on iPhone and computer, StockShop opens in the browser and can be added to the home screen.
help.a_setup: Create your account, add your products (one by one or from an Excel file), then make your first sale. A five-step guide walks you through it in the app.
help.a_offline: The checkout keeps working. Sales stay on the device and are sent as soon as the network is back; a sale with a problem on arrival is flagged "to check", never lost.
help.a_shops: Yes: {starter} with Starter, {pro} with Pro, {business} with Business, and a custom offer beyond that. Follow each shop or all of them together, and stock can move from one to another.
help.q_team: Can my staff see my margins?
help.a_team: No, unless you decide so. Each member has a role per shop; purchase prices and margins are visible only to the people you choose, and the rule is enforced by our servers.
help.a_lang: The app is in French, English and Hausa. Each shop works in its own country's currency.
help.contact_text: Write to us and we will answer by email. Once logged in, the app's Help section also shows every screen step by step.
